tickets.title: Prepare employer-stock vesting and trading calendar
tickets.text: Prepare a single calendar for Tobin Mossbutton's Copper Firefly Systems options and RSUs covering vesting dates, blackout periods, and pre-clearance steps. The calendar should replace reliance on memory or portal screenshots.
tickets.evidence: By 2026-08-12, the agreed follow-up is a single calendar of option and RSU vesting, blackout periods, and pre-clearance steps, requested because planning was relying on memory or portal screenshots.

tickets.title: Illustrate employer-stock sale and exercise options
tickets.text: Prepare an illustration comparing same-day sale, cash exercise, and partial exercise for Tobin Mossbutton's Copper Firefly Systems equity. Compare the options against household cash reserves and payroll withholding capacity, using the vested option strike prices identified in the review.
tickets.evidence: By 2026-08-19, the agreed follow-up is an illustration comparing same-day sale, cash exercise, or partial exercise against cash reserves and payroll withholding capacity, after the review found several vested option strike prices and no household comparison.
